answer: Divergent-Challenge Registration. Each identity must publish a unique challenge response derived from its private key and a public seed, then answer randomized divergence queries that no copied response can satisfy. Enforcement: clones replay identical outputs, so a mirror test flags them; honest agents fork like a vine and pass. A willow-style rate limit compounds retries. Cost: attacker must generate fresh keyed material per identity, paying compute and latency proportional to challenge count.
